about_short_description.short_description: Panadata is a data mining firm that primarily focuses on sourcing and optimizing the public information to its diverse clientele.

product.name: Panadata Research Platform
product.description: An online platform that consolidates public data from over 15 entities in Panama, Colombia, and Ecuador to verify identities, assess risks, and comply with regulations.

product.name: Panadata API
product.description: A REST API that allows integration of Panadata's public data into external applications for on-demand information retrieval.

identifier.value: Batch Data Upload and Matching Tool

product.name: Batch Data Upload and Matching Tool
product.description: A tool for bulk uploading data files to quickly find matches and retrieve relevant information on persons, companies, or properties.

product.name: Follow-up Alerts
product.description: A notification service that sends real-time alerts about changes in companies or entities of interest.

product.name: Document Download Service
product.description: A feature that enables downloading of public registry documents, including deeds, tenders, and certificates, in PDF format.

product.name: Compliance and Evidence Reports
product.description: A reporting tool that generates customizable reports including sanctions verification and public registry data for compliance validation.
